body.title: Reshape the document view: pre→textarea, save wiring, gen-guarded replies, onScratchSave seam, replySaved
body.summary: Reshape the scratchpad document view in vscode-plugin/src/panels/scratch-panels.ts: pre → CSP-safe textarea (content via .value), documentBootstrap(gen, id), dirty tracking with save button + title suffix, Ctrl/Cmd+S and click posting document-channel 'scratch-save', gen-guarded 'scratch-saved' handling, a new panels.replySaved(gen, msg) and a new ScratchPanelsDeps.onScratchSave seam, and send-to-chat re-read from the textarea's own selection; all pinned in scratch-panel.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: documentBodyHtml emits <textarea id="insrc-scratchdoc" class="scratch-doc"> (not pre) plus the hidden save button
scratch-content push sets doc.value, never innerHTML/textContent
documentBootstrap gains the id parameter — documentBootstrap(gen, id)
input → dirty (save button visible + panel title '•' suffix); keydown Ctrl/Cmd+S and save-button click post 'scratch-save' { id, gen: docGeneration, text: doc.value }
'scratch-saved' honored only when msg.gen === live docGeneration and id matches → clear dirty on ok / show error on ok=false; stale-gen replies ignored
send-to-chat re-pointed to the textarea selection API (selectionStart/selectionEnd over doc.value on select/keyup/mouseup), still capUtf8-capped
ScratchPanels gains replySaved(gen, msg) targeting the live document generation; the panel's onMessage exposes a new deps.onScratchSave seam validated against showingId + live docGeneration
singleton panel, docGeneration/epoch guards, pendingContent replay and wrap() drop logging unchanged
scratch-panel.test.ts source + behavioral pins cover all of the above

tests.name: scratch-panel.test.ts: documentBodyHtml emits <textarea id="insrc-scratchdoc"> and the save button; documentBootstrap pins the scratch-save post with gen + keydown Ctrl/Cmd+S + scratch-saved handler honoring only gen === docGeneration + textarea selectionStart/selectionEnd send-to-chat

scratch-panel.test.ts behavioral: input event sets dirty (save button visible, title suffix via setTitle), 'scratch-saved' ok with matching gen clears dirty, ok=false keeps dirty and shows error, stale-gen reply ignored; scratch-content sets textarea .value (not textContent/innerHTML); send-to-chat reads selection from textarea selectionStart/selectionEnd over doc.value and posts capUtf8-capped text

scratch-panel.test.ts: send-to-chat post via textarea selection (selectionStart/selectionEnd) present in the new bootstrap; capUtf8 behavior untouched (existing tests); existing ISSUE-3183af2a tests (wrap() drop logging, reveal(true), popup icons) still pass
